caseNameFull: Seattle Times Co., dba The Seattle Times v. Rhinehart

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Wash. [Certiorari granted, 464 U. S. 812.] Motion of respondent Keith Milton Rhinehart to present oral argument pro se and for divided argument denied. Motion of Malcolm L. Edwards, Esquire, to permit Haim Habib, Esquire, to present oral argument pro hac vice on behalf of respondents denied.
